data.rationale: The proposal captures the same EDGAR 10-K, Wikipedia infobox and Account brief email flow with the right parameters. However, it uses EDGAR advanced full-text search instead of the company search box, and it ends with "Send" where the true workflow says not to send and to click Discard. It also leaves the recipient as a full email address rather than {manager}@example.com, and it doesn't mention switching between tabs or the Mail app. Sending an email would be a harmful automation error, so it is only moderately feasible.
